title: The Nights
lyrics:
[00:02.31]Hey
[00:02.79]Once upon a younger year
[00:04.45]When all our shadows disappeared
[00:06.32]The animals inside came out to play
[00:10.11]Went face to face with all our fears
[00:12.31]Learned our lessons through the tears
[00:14.08]Made memories we knew would never fade
[00:17.29]One day, my father, he told me, "Son, don't let it slip away"
[00:21.59]He took me in his arms, I heard him say
[00:24.96]"When you get older, your wild heart will live for younger days
[00:29.38]Think of me if ever you're afraid"
[00:32.45]He said, "One day, you'll leave this world behind
[00:36.26]So live a life you will remember"
[00:40.17]My father told me when I was just a child
[00:43.93]These are the nights that never die
[00:47.25]My father told me
[01:18.72]When thunderclouds start pouring down
[01:20.86]Light a fire they can't put out
[01:22.73]Carve your name into those shining stars
[01:25.80]He said, "Go venture far beyond the shores
[01:28.44]Don't forsake this life of yours
[01:30.24]I'll guide you home no matter where you are"
